Body: Hi Mian,  Thanks for sharing the brief — this is exactly the type of leadership work I’m brought in for.  My background isn’t traditional coaching. I work with founders and senior leaders who are already capable and commercially driven, but who are carrying too much because the business has outgrown its current operating model.  In small businesses, leadership pressure usually shows up as:  The founder becoming the bottleneck  Strategy existing, but execution being inconsistent  Sales and delivery relying too heavily on a small number of people   My role is to help leaders create clarity, structure and leverage, without slowing momentum.  I typically support across:  Leadership clarity & decision-making – what should sit with you vs the team  Strategy into execution – turning intent into priorities and outcomes  Commercial & sales leadership – aligning leadership behaviour to revenue  Building leverage – so the business doesn’t rely on one individual   I work through focused, outcomes-led engagements (often 6–12 weeks), combining a practical leadership diagnostic with regular 1:1 working sessions centred on real decisions and live challenges — not theory.  Leaders usually see:  Fewer decisions stuck with them  Stronger execution and accountability  Improved commercial focus  Reduced personal strain with better control   If helpful, I’d welcome a short conversation to understand what’s driving the need now and what success would look like for you.  Best, Phil

Often, it’s not a lack of skill holding people back it’s how their experience is presented on paper.  A powerful resume speaks with clarity, confidence, and direction. It doesn’t just list responsibilities; it positions you as the solution employers are looking for. With the right structure, language, and strategy, that single document can open doors that once felt closed.  That’s where I come in. I help transform resumes into compelling, results-driven narratives that attract recruiters and secure interviews. I’ll guide you through the next steps.  I look forward to helping you confidently tell your story and move closer to the opportunities you deserve.  Best regards, Courtney
